ValidationRule.description: Stops editing of special pricing fields when special pricing is approved.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: IF( AND(ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE(Special_Pricing_Status__c) , 'Approved'),OR( ISCHANGED( Special_Pricing_Status__c ), ISCHANGED( Special_Pricing_Submitter__c ), ISCHANGED( Discount_Percentage__c ), ISCHANGED( Indirect_Customer__c ), ISCHANGED( Competitor_Name__c ) )) , true, false)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Special pricing fields cannot be changed if a special pricing request has already been approved.
